title: Maracaibo
subtitle: 17th-Century Caribbean Maritime Strategy Campaign
tagline: Sail the treacherous waters of the Spanish Main across an evolving 12-chapter story campaign.
loreSummary: Set sail in the 17th century as a skilled captain navigating the Caribbean. Deliver goods, upgrade your ship, complete adventurous quests, and ally with rival European empires as the political board landscape permanently shifts from chapter to chapter.
keyFeatures: Masterful heavy strategy design by Alexander Pfister with dynamic round rondel movement
Branching 12-chapter campaign where story cards permanently alter board locations and quests
Deep engine-building: improve your ship, deliver goods, enlist crew, and explore wilderness trails
Multi-faceted scoring with shifting geopolitical influence among England, France, and Spain
